title: Pitch Looks Solid, Yet Its First Drop Took 8 Years
hook: Pitch looks solid, but the first recorded drop took 8 years to fall.
closing: A material can flow too slowly to notice; patience reveals behavior a quick glance misses.
question: What would you wait years to measure?

segments.say: The first Queensland drop took 8 years in this timeline. A solid-looking material was flowing all along.
Dublin's first filmed drop came after 69 years. First filmed does not necessarily mean the first drop ever fell.
Pitch is about 230 billion times as viscous as water in this comparison. Flow can be real while remaining almost invisible.
